title: KALLAX insert with door
scope: Manual steps 1–11 (two routes). Fitted in one compartment; excludes wall attachment.

overview.title: Check the parts
overview.hint: Check the hardware against p3. The door insert itself has only two parts: the folding frame and the door panel.

left.label: Hinges on left
left.note: Hinges on the left wall of the compartment, door opens to the left (manual p6–p10; based on p7, p9)

right.label: Hinges on right
right.note: Hinges on the right wall of the compartment, door opens to the right (manual p11–p15; based on p13, p14)

1.title: Fold the frame
1.hint: Unfold the folding frame, fold it along the creases into a U shape, and fold the narrow strips at both ends onto the outside of the side panels.

2.title: Fit the hinges
2.hint: Fit the two hinges to the door panel, 2 screws each. After this the manual splits into two routes by which side the hinges go on.
2.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p5 — the hinge screws turn as they go in.

left:3.title: Mark line (Left)
left:3.hint: Place the marking gauge on the front edge of the compartment floor on the left side and draw a pencil line (do not put the gauge on backwards).

left:4.title: Mark line (Right)
left:4.hint: Draw a line on the right side in the same way.

left:5.title: Push in the frame
left:5.hint: Push the U-shaped frame into the compartment.

left:6.title: Left lower plate
left:6.hint: Press the frame against the left wall with its front edge on the pencil line, and fit the lower hinge mounting plate.
left:6.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p7 — the screws turn as they go in. Steps 7 and 8 have no rotation arrow, so those screws do not turn.

left:7.title: Left upper plate
left:7.hint: Fit the upper hinge mounting plate in the same way.

left:8.title: Right side screws
left:8.hint: On the right side, press the frame in, align it with the pencil line and drive in 2 screws directly.

left:9.title: Hang the door
left:9.hint: Hang the hinges on the mounting plates: hook on, press down, then tighten.

left:10.title: Knob
left:10.hint: Fit the knob; the screw goes in from the inside of the door.
left:10.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p9 — the knob screw turns as it goes in.

left:11.title: Bumper pads
left:11.hint: Stick one bumper pad on each of the upper and lower corners on the opening side of the back of the door (1 sheet = 2 pads).

right:3.title: Mark line (Right)
right:3.hint: Place the marking gauge on the front edge of the compartment floor on the right side and draw a pencil line (do not put the gauge on backwards).

right:4.title: Mark line (Left)
right:4.hint: Draw a line on the left side in the same way.

right:5.title: Push in the frame
right:5.hint: Push the U-shaped frame into the compartment.

right:6.title: Right lower plate
right:6.hint: Press the frame against the right wall with its front edge on the pencil line, and fit the lower hinge mounting plate.
right:6.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p13 — the screws turn as they go in. Steps 7 and 8 have no rotation arrow, so those screws do not turn.

right:7.title: Right upper plate
right:7.hint: Fit the upper hinge mounting plate in the same way.

right:8.title: Left side screws
right:8.hint: On the left side, press the frame in, align it with the pencil line and drive in 2 screws directly.

right:9.title: Hang the door
right:9.hint: Hang the hinges on the mounting plates: hook on, press down, then tighten.

right:10.title: Knob
right:10.hint: Fit the knob; the screw goes in from the inside of the door.
right:10.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p15 — the knob screw turns as it goes in.

right:11.title: Bumper pads
right:11.hint: Stick one bumper pad on each of the upper and lower corners on the opening side of the back of the door (1 sheet = 2 pads).
